description: This Java class handles commands related to creating loan schedule variations within the loan account module of the Fineract project. It uses annotations to designate its command type and integrates with a service to process the request.

classes.name: LoanScheduleCreateVariationCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles command processing for creating variations in loan schedules, identified by the command type 'LOAN' with action 'CREATESCHEDULEEXCEPTIONS'. Implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface to process commands.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a JSON command to add loan schedule variations by delegating to the 'LoanScheduleWritePlatformService'.
